विबन्ध् वि-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्-
धुम्, to bind or fasten on different sides, fasten on
both sides, fasten; to stretch out, extend: Intens.
-बाबधे, Ved. to lavish, bestow liberally, distribute,
(according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

. वि-बाब-
धे = वि-बध्नाति = ददाति; according to others
[]
the form वि-बाबधे is assigned to वि-बाध्); to set
free.

वि-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound or fastened on different
sides, fastened; entirely stopped, obstructed, consti-
pated.
वि-बध्य, ind. having bound or fastened.

वि-बन्ध, अस्, m. binding, obstruction, constipa-
tion, ischury.

वि-बन्धन, अम्, n. the act of fastening or bind-
ing on both sides, (परस्पर-विबन्धन, अस्, आ,
अम्, mutually bound, depending on each other.)

विबाध् वि-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -बाधि-
तुम्, to press or drive asunder or in different direc-
tions; to press hard upon, drive away, chase away;
to oppress, molest, harass, torment, persecute, pain,
injure: Intens. वि-बाबधे (see under वि-बन्ध्).
वि-बाधा, f. pressure, pain, agony, anguish.

विबाल्य वि-बाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. passed
beyond a state of youth, in full vigour; swollen (said
of a river).

विबुध् वि-बुध्, cl. 4. A. -बुध्यते, -बोद्-
धुम्, to awake (intrans.), be awake or awakened;
to become conscious, perceive, observe, learn, ascer-
tain: Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्, to awaken; to
cause to perceive or observe, make conscious, restore
to consciousness.

1. वि-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, wide awake, awakened,
aroused, awake, expanded, blossomed; clever, expe-
rienced, knowing, skilful (e. g. कर्मसु विबुद्-
धः, skilful in business).
—विबुद्ध-कमल, अस्,
आ, अम्, having expanded lotuses.

2. वि-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, without consciousness,
unconscious.

वि-बुध, अस्, m. a learned or wise man, teacher,
Paṇḍit; a god, immortal; the moon; N. of the
author of the Janma-pradīpa.
—विबुध-प्रिया, f.
‘favourite of the gods,’ N. of a metre.
—विबुध-
विजय, अस्, m. a victory (won) by the gods.
—वि-
बुध-विद्विष्, ट्, or विबुध-शत्रु, उस्, m. a foe
of the gods; a demon.
—विबुधाधिपति (˚ध-
अध्˚), इस्, or विबुधेश्वर (˚ध-ईश्˚), अस्, m. the
lord of the immortals.

वि-बुधान, अस्, m. a wise man, teacher, pre-
ceptor.

वि-बुध्य, ind. having become conscious, having
perceived or learnt.

1. वि-बोध, अस्, m. awaking; perceiving, observ-
ing, discovering; intelligence; (in the drama) the
unfolding of the faculties, becoming conscious, awak-
ing, (one of the Vyabhicāra-bhāvas.)

2. वि-बोध, अस्, m. want of consciousness, inat-
tention, absence of mind.

वि-बोधन, अम्, n. the act of awakening, awak-
ing.

वि-बोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, aroused; caused
to perceive or know, instructed.

विब्बोक विब्बोक, अस्, m. (also written बिब्-
बोक, विव्वोक, q. q. v. v.), (in erotic poetry) affec-
tation of indifference to a beloved object through
pride and conceit.

विब्रू वि-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. A. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते,
&c. (see rt. ब्रू), to speak out, say, speak, utter;
to speak in detail, particularize, interpret, explain,
declare; to speak of or about (with acc.); to speak
at variance; to say what is false, declare falsely, ex-
plain falsely; to contradict, disagree with, be at vari-
ance with; to dispute, contend about (Ved. A.).

वि-ब्रुवत्, अन्, अती (ep. अन्ती), अत्, speaking out,
speaking, saying, declaring, particularizing, interpret-
ing; speaking falsely, saying what is untrue or
unjust.

वि-ब्रुवाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking out, saying,
declaring, uttering.

वि-बिभित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to break asunder,
purposing to cleave or pierce.

वि-बोभुवत्, अत्, अती, अत् (fr. the Intens.), Ved.
spreading in every direction.
वीबुकोश वीबुकोश, अस्, m. (?), a cowri.
वि-बुभूषा, f. wish to manifest one's self.

वि-बुभूषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to appear or
manifest one's self.
